datasets.name: ds_nrw_weekly
queryLines:
SELECT
  date_trunc('WEEK', obs_date) AS week,
  round(100 * sum(nrw_ml) / sum(inflow_ml), 2) AS network_nrw_pct,
  count_if(leak_alert) AS dma_alert_days
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY

datasets.name: ds_break_cohorts
queryLines:
SELECT
  material,
  install_era,
  count(*) AS segments,
  round(sum(length_m) / 1000, 1) AS km,
  sum(breaks_total) AS breaks,
  round(sum(breaks_total) / (sum(length_m) / 1000.0) / max(years_observed), 2) AS breaks_per_km_yr,
  round(
    100.0 * sum(breaks_on_hot_dry_days) / nullif(sum(breaks_total), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_on_hot_dry_days
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: ds_dma_map
queryLines:
WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT
    max(obs_date) d
  FROM
    adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
)
SELECT
  n.dma_id,
  n.dma_name,
  n.region_name,
  d.latitude,
  d.longitude,
  d.connections,
  round(avg(n.nrw_pct), 2) AS nrw_pct_90d,
  round(avg(n.mnf_vs_peer_ratio), 3) AS mnf_vs_peer_90d,
  sum(n.main_breaks) AS main_breaks_90d,
  max(
    CASE
      WHEN n.obs_date = l.d THEN n.leak_alert
    END
  ) AS leak_alert_now
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n
    JOIN adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_dim_dma d
      ON d.dma_id = n.dma_id
    CROSS JOIN last_day l
WHERE
  n.obs_date > date_sub(l.d, 90)
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY nrw_pct_90d DESC

datasets.name: ds_leak_dma_vs_peer
queryLines:
SELECT
  obs_date,
  dma_id,
  nrw_pct,
  peer_median_nrw_pct,
  mnf_vs_peer_ratio_14d,
  leak_alert
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
WHERE
  dma_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      dma_id
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
    WHERE
      leak_alert
  )
ORDER BY
  obs_date

datasets.name: ds_operations_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  obs_date,
  urban_storage_level_pct,
  bulk_storage_level_pct,
  murray_ml_pumped,
  pumping_cost_aud_per_ml,
  desal_production_ml,
  water_treatment_production_ml,
  recycled_water_supplied_ml,
  avg_rainfall_mm
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily
ORDER BY
  obs_date

datasets.name: ds_high_risk_segments
queryLines:
SELECT
  main_id,
  dma_name,
  region_name,
  material,
  install_year,
  soil_type,
  diameter_mm,
  length_m,
  breaks_total,
  round(risk_score, 2) AS risk_score_breaks_per_km_yr,
  round(expected_breaks_per_yr, 3) AS expected_breaks_per_yr,
  repair_cost_aud,
  last_break_on,
  latitude,
  longitude
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk
WHERE
  risk_tier = 'High'
ORDER BY
  risk_score DESC

datasets.name: ds_risk_tiers
queryLines:
SELECT
  risk_tier,
  count(*) AS segments,
  round(sum(breaks_total) / sum(length_m / 1000.0) / max(years_observed), 2) AS breaks_per_km_yr
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk
GROUP BY
  risk_tier

datasets.name: ds_billing_quarterly
queryLines:
SELECT
  bill_quarter,
  bill_quarter_label,
  region_name,
  sum(bills) AS bills,
  sum(total_billed_aud) AS total_billed_aud,
  sum(overdue_aud) AS overdue_aud,
  round(sum(overdue_bills) / sum(bills), 4) AS overdue_rate,
  sum(hardship_bills) AS hardship_bills,
  sum(concession_bills) AS concession_bills,
  round(sum(est_meter_unregistered_kl), 0) AS est_meter_unregistered_kl
FROM
  adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_customer_billing_quarterly
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: ds_register
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_type,
  event_id,
  event_date,
  date_trunc('MONTH', event_date) AS event_month,
  title,
  region_name,
  impact_value,
  impact_unit,
  report_on_file,
  regulator,
  suggested_status,
  suggested_reason
FROM
  adllabs_096.default.incident_events
ORDER BY event_date DESC

datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines:
WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT
    max(obs_date) d
  FROM
    adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      count(*)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n
        JOIN last_day l
          ON n.obs_date = l.d
    WHERE
      n.leak_alert
  ) AS dmas_on_leak_alert,
  (
    SELECT
      round(100 * sum(nrw_ml) / sum(inflow_ml), 2)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n,
      last_day l
    WHERE
      n.obs_date > date_sub(l.d, 28)
  ) AS network_nrw_pct_28d,
  (
    SELECT
      count(*)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk
    WHERE
      risk_tier = 'High'
  ) AS high_risk_segments,
  (
    SELECT
      round(urban_storage_level_pct, 1)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily
    ORDER BY
      obs_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS urban_storage_pct,
  (
    SELECT
      count(*)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.default.incident_events
    WHERE
      suggested_status = 'Open'
  ) AS open_register_events,
  (
    SELECT
      max(obs_date)
    FROM
      adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily
  ) AS data_as_of

**Data as of {{ field:as_of }}**

Synthetic data for Torrens Gulf Water Corporation. Not real operational figures.

**How the leak alert works.** A DMA goes on leak alert when both conditions hold:

* its 14-day minimum night flow is at least 6% above the peer median, and
* its non-revenue water (NRW) is at least 0.75 percentage points above the peer median NRW.

**About the risk score.** risk_score is a credibility-weighted break rate (breaks per km per year). Short pipes with few observations are pulled toward their cohort average, so a pipe isn't ranked high just because it is long.
